# Ulaş Arslan

> Customer Experience and Operations leader, team lead and product builder based in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

Ulaş Arslan connects support, product, sales and operations. He turns recurring customer signals into scalable processes, better decisions and practical products.

## Verified professional facts
- Current role: Customer Experience Manager at Speaksee, reporting directly to the COO and owning CX structure across support, product and operations.
- Product: Solo builder of Renewal Radar by Sighub, a HubSpot app that converts CRM renewal signals into one clear owner task.
- Team leadership: Led a support team of more than 20 agents at LiteBit.
- Crisis recovery: Cleared an approximately 3,000-ticket backlog after a data breach and helped improve Trustpilot from approximately 2.4 to 4.0.
- Previous environments: accessibility technology, fintech, regulated digital assets and healthcare.
- Location: Rotterdam, Netherlands.

## Expertise
CX Strategy & Operations; Team Leadership; Process Design & Automation; Customer Signal Analysis; Cross-Functional Alignment; Support Optimization.
